answer: Make every account keep its own large scratch table, generated from its address with a memory-hard function, and answer surprise lookups into it each epoch within seconds. Rebuilding the table on demand is too slow, so a fleet must store one full table per fake. That storage bill climbs in a steady delta with each clone, and a farm that tries to share tables gets caught when two accounts miss the same lookups. Honest agents pay once; a sybil army hits its zenith fast and stalls like a truck on the tundra.
